Editorial explanation of the predefined case

In the initial case, neither price nor delivery time is documented. The claim is unsupported by the available evidence, which does not prove it false. Try the correction, then the source variant documenting the free service.

This explanation was written for the documented variants. It is not an analysis generated from your free text.

Original corpus CSV · Original manifest · Import provenance and fingerprints

METHOD & LIMITS

Checking is not approving.

What this demo establishes

Empty fields, recognised variables, exact equality, calculated similarity, locks and version combinations. Known claims are compared with structured scenario facts.

For free text, lexical cues can help review. They verify neither meaning nor negation nor every possible claim. Unevaluated points stay explicit.

What Google displays

Google can compose a result title from several sources and a snippet from page content. Supplied tags do not guarantee the displayed text. Lengths are indicative.

Google · title links
Google · snippets

Reproduce the kit’s similarity calculation

Text cleaned by the published plain function, lowercase, Unicode letter/number words, sets of word bigrams, Jaccard intersection / union; threshold ≥ 0.72. One word forms a singleton; two empty sets return 1; one empty set returns 0. Repetitions disappear in the set, accents remain distinct. Exact duplication is compared before similarity.

Resemblance is neither established cannibalisation nor an SEO score.

Fingerprints, decisions and exports

Historical source_hash covers only four fields. The demo uses a separate fictional-evidence fingerprint: SHA-256 of sorted-key JSON containing scenario, version, language, text, facts, unknowns and optional comparisons. The approval combination also includes proposal and rules.

The export is an identified educational session, not a validated parent-contract output. Provider, model and real reviewer are not invented. CSV protects cells that could be interpreted as formulas; JSON preserves exact text.

Parent contract kept separately · Five scenarios, rules and expected results

Original data remains CC BY 4.0 (Edikka). New code and fictional scenarios are MIT. The original licence still mentions 1.0.0; the kit manifest identifies version 1.0.2.
